final_message:
I fixed the source code in the inventory package as follows:

- In export.py, I fixed to_csv_row to properly quote names containing commas or double quotes according to RFC 4180.
- In pricing.py, I fixed parse_price to handle commas in prices and accounting style parentheses for negative values. I also fixed apply_discount to use Decimal arithmetic and round half up correctly.
- In report.py, I fixed low_stock to return names of items whose quantity is strictly below the threshold, sorted alphabetically ignoring case.

These changes make the functions behave as their docstrings specify and make the existing tests pass. The test suite runs with the provided tests in tests/test_report.py.

No tests or other files were modified.
